title: Keep eating inside a consistent 10-hour window.
subtitle: Eating window
rationale: Test a stable eating window when longer or more variable covered windows predict weaker sleep, recovery, or output.

evidence.summary: Time-restricted eating studies support testing a consistent daily eating window.

indications: Eating start and end times swing widely day to day.
Late grazing extends the eating window past 12 hours.
Sleep or digestion complaints accompany irregular meal timing.
